text: This application proposes to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law for the properties at 2490-2514 Yonge Street, 10-12 Castlefield Avenue, and portions of 20 Castlefield Avenue and 567 Duplex Avenue to permit a 14-storey (50.4 metres - excluding mechanical penthouse) mixed use building containing 150 dwelling units and retail uses at grade along Yonge Street. Portions of the existing heritage building (Capitol Theatre) located at 2490-2506 Yonge St are proposed to be conserved. The Capitol Theatre façade, and existing canopy structure, are proposed to be incorporated into the development. The Capitol Theatre would be commemorated by replication of its volume on the ground floor, and the vestibule space would be rebuilt to a similar footprint.
